title: engine.session.stalled payload v1
description: An open PR's session stalled (X1, scripts/stall-report): no push for push-guard.stall_no_push_s (no_push), a red gate with no push for push-guard.stall_red_gate_s after it (red_gate), or a comment that waits on an owner decision with no later Decision line (owner_wait, DECIDE, THEN REPORT). The orchestrator acts on it; nobody has to ask.

since.description: When the stall started: the last push, the red verdict or the waiting comment.

last_push.description: The branch's latest push the forge recorded.

last_gate.description: The latest gate verdict on the PR's log.

last_gate_at.description: When the latest gate verdict was recorded (UTC).

detail.description: The waiting line for owner_wait, else null.
